blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Prosecutors have asked the International Criminal Court (ICC) to allow the advance submission of testimony and other evidence from three witnesses on the Davao Death Squad’s targeting of alleged criminals in former President Rodrigo Duterte’s crimes against humanity case. In a 10-page submission published on the ICC website on Nov. 3 (Nov. 4 in Manila), Acting Prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang requested the formal submission of the statements, transcripts, and associated material of three witnesses identified only as P-0019, P-1032, and P-1409. “Their evidence primarily relates to the Davao Death Squad (“DDS”)’s targeting of alleged criminals,” the prosecution said […]...
